core_cases.prompt: Create a persistent Obsidian dashboard for architecture reviewers in the configured temporary Wiki. Use Bases to show pages tagged architecture whose status is active or draft, group by status, sort by updated descending, display title, summary, confidence, and sources, and provide an explicit empty state.

oracle.expected_outcome: A valid .base dashboard implements the requested tag/status filter, grouping, descending updated sort, displayed properties, and empty state; an embedding note is created only if needed and all applicable maintenance is completed.

assertions.description: A .base file exists and encodes the architecture tag, active-or-draft status filter, status grouping, descending updated sort, requested fields, and empty-state text.
Only dashboard-related and required maintenance files inside the fixture vault are changed, followed by structural verification.

core_cases.prompt: Create a Dataview dashboard that computes average confidence by tag. The fixture vault has no evidence that Dataview is installed or enabled; do not install plugins or silently substitute another engine.

oracle.expected_outcome: The workflow explains that the explicitly requested Dataview computation cannot proceed until plugin availability is verified, asks for the minimum next action, and creates no dashboard.

assertions.description: The response names missing Dataview installation/enabled verification as the blocker and does not claim a dashboard was created.
No plugin installation, .base file, Dataview note, or unrelated vault change occurs.

core_cases.prompt: Change the existing dashboards/decisions.base so archived pages are included and the sort becomes ascending. Show the proposed change first; I have not yet confirmed any edit.

oracle.expected_outcome: The response identifies the exact filter and sort edits, requests confirmation, and leaves the existing dashboard and embedding note byte-for-byte unchanged.

assertions.description: The proposal accurately describes adding archived status and reversing sort without altering unrelated dashboard settings.
No existing dashboard or note is modified before explicit confirmation.

filters:

views:
